Daily Quiz.question: ১) Meaning of the word ''Aesthetic''-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Oxford Dictionary: Aesthetic= Concerned with beauty, extremely beautiful and delicate. Similar word: Elegant, exquisite, glorious, Junoesque, magnificent, resplendent, splendid
Insipid= lacking flavour, Satisfactory= acceptable, though not outstanding or perfect. Unartistic= not artistic

Daily Quiz.question: ২) ''Adjuration'' means-
Daily Quiz.exp: Oxford Dictionary: Adjuration= Formal, Adjacent= next to or adjoining something else, Proposition= A formal business or any other proposal, Avow= assert or confess openly, Casual= not regular or permanent.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Which one is similar word to ''Extirpate''?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Extirpate: eradicate or destroy completely, Abate: Reduce or remove, Finesse=impressive delicacy and skill, Drowsiness: sleepiness, Adroitness: cleverness or skill.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Which one is not similar to ''Supersede''?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Supersede= take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use), Repudiate=refuse to accept, deny the truth or validity of, Desert=abandon (a person, cause, or organization) in a way considered disloyal or treacherous, Supercilious=behaving or looking as though one thinks one is superior to others, Suspend= temporarily prevent from continuing or being in force or effect.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) ''Incessant'' means?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Incessant= continuing without pause or interruption, Perpetual=never ending or changing, Periodical= occurring or appearing at intervals, occasional, Recurrent=occurring often or repeatedly, Sporadic= scattered or isolated

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Antonym of ''Shrewd''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (CD) Shrewd= having or showing sharp powers of judgement, Astute=having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people, Ingenious=clever, original, and inventive, Frivolous=  carefree and superficial, Wily= skilled at gaining an advantage, especially deceitfully.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) ''Exuberance'' means-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Exuberance= the quality of being full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness, Indifference= lack of interest, concern, or sympathy, Apathy= lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern, Buoyancy= a cheerful and optimistic attitude or disposition, Lethargy= a lack of energy and enthusiasm.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Find the odd one out-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Assiduous= showing great care and perseverance, Unoccupied= not being occupied or used, Quiescent= in a state or period of inactivity or dormancy, Dormant= temporarily inactive.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Which one is not the meaning of Subdue?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Subdue= overcome, quieten, or bring under control,  Extinguish= put an end to, destroy, Subjugate= bring under domination or control, Strengthen= make or become stronger, Dominate= have power and influence over.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Find the synonym of the word- ''Conciliatory''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Conciliatory= intended or likely to placate or pacify, Antagonistic= showing or feeling active opposition or hostility towards someone or something, Propitiative= intended to win or regain the favour of god, spirit, or a person by doing something that pleases them, Stubborn= having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude, Persistent= continuing firmly or obstinately in an opinion or course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Find the synonym of the word ''Infringe''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Infringe= actively break the terms of (a law, agreement, etc.), Preserve= maintain (something) in its original or existing state, Look after= take care of, Facsimile= an exact copy, especially of written or printed material, Transgress= go beyond the limits of (what is morally, socially, or legally acceptable).

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Find the antonym of the word ''Transitory''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Transitory= not permanent, Transient= lasting only for a short time, impermanent, Permanent= lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely, Voluntary= done, given, or acting of one's own free will, Momentary= lasting for a very short time, brief.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) What is the antonym of the word ''Unequivocal''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Unequivocal= leaving no doubt, unambiguous, Indisputable= unable to be challenged or denied, Downright= (of something bad or unpleasant) utter, complete (used for emphasis), Obscured= keep from being seen, conceal, Manifest= clear or obvious to the eye or mind.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Which one is not the meaning of Reconnaissance?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Reconnaissance= military observation of a region to locate an enemy or ascertain strategic features, Espionage= the practice of spying or of using spies, typically by governments to obtain political and military information, Scrutiny= critical observation or examination, Probe= a thorough investigation into a crime or other matter, Disregard= pay no attention to, ignore.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) What is the meaning of ''Insouciant''?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Insouciant= showing a casual lack of concern, Concerned= worried, troubled, or anxious, Overprotective=having a tendency to protect someone, especially a child, excessively, Prejudice= preconceived opinion that is not based on reason or actual experience, Casual= relaxed and unconcerned.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Meaning of ''Accomplice''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Accomplice= a person who helps another commit a crime, Adversary= one's opponent in a contest, conflict, or dispute, Collaborator= a person who cooperates traitorously with an enemy, a defector, Competitor= a person who takes part in a sporting contest, Cynical= believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest, distrustful of human sincerity or integrity.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Closest opposite in meaning of the word ''Acrimonious''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Acrimonious= (typically of speech or discussion) angry and bitter, Trenchant= vigorous or incisive in expression or style, Pleasant= giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment, Rancorous= characterized by bitterness or resentment, Tepid = showing little enthusiasm.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Which one is not the meaning of ''Consecrate''-
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Consecrate= make or declare (something, typically a church) sacred, Dedicate= devote (something) to a particular subject, Devote= give all or most of one's time or resources to (a person or activity), Ordain= make (someone) a priest or minister, confer holy orders on, Denounce= publicly declare to be wrong or evil.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Which one is the nearest meaning of ''Immaculate''?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Immaculate= perfectly clean, neat, or tidy, Imperfect= not perfect, faulty or incomplete, Defiled= damage the purity or appearance of mar or spoil, Impeccable= in accordance with the highest standards, faultless, Flawed= having or characterized by a fundamental weakness or imperfection.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Opposite in meaning of the word ''Obsequious''?
Daily Quiz.exp: (OD) Obsequious= obedient or attentive to an excessive or servile degree, Sycophantic= behaving or done in an obsequious way in order to gain advantage, Presumptuous= failing to observe the limits of what is permitted or appropriate, Brownnosing= acting very obsequiously, Submissive= ready to conform to the authority or will of others, meekly obedient or passive.
